description: Rewrite satuyangterpenting-week1.html with much longer, more substantive article content. Each of the 21 posts inside textarea elements must be expanded from ~20 lines to ~50-60 lines of rich, emotional, storytelling content with more paragraphs, deeper problem exploration, more product details, and better narrative structure.
steps: Read /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week1.html to understand the full current structure
Rewrite the ENTIRE file, keeping the same HTML wrapper (CSS styles, navigation, post-card structure, JavaScript) but completely expanding the content inside each of the 21 textarea elements

Each article inside a textarea must now follow this expanded structure: (1) Opening bold emotional hook question (2-3 sentences), (2) Relatable personal story/scenario that draws the reader in (1 paragraph of 3-4 sentences), (3) Problem description with statistics and facts using highlight/underline (2 paragraphs), (4) More emotional questions that make the reader reflect (2-3 questions), (5) Famous quote in blockquote, (6) Product introduction with DETAILED benefits explained in simple language (2-3 paragraphs covering features, benefits, how it works), (7) Real-life scenario showing how the product helps (1 paragraph), (8) Image placeholder, (9) Strong emotional closing paragraph with urgency, (10) 4 CTA buttons with inline styles

Week 1 themes per day: Day 1 - Asuransi Kesehatan (MiUltimate HealthCare), Day 2 - Proteksi Jiwa (MiWealth Protection), Day 3 - Dana Pendidikan (MiEducation), Day 4 - Pensiun (MiRetirement Booster), Day 5 - Penyakit Kritis (MiEarly Critical Care), Day 6 - Peluang Karir Agen (recruitment), Day 7 - Investasi+Proteksi (MiWealth Link)

Three posts per day (Pagi/Siang/Malam) should approach the same daily theme from different angles - morning posts focus on awareness/fear, afternoon posts on education/facts, evening posts on reflection/action
Use diverse famous quotes from: Benjamin Franklin, Warren Buffett, Suze Orman, Robert Kiyosaki, Dave Ramsey, Nelson Mandela, Winston Churchill, Confucius, etc.
Increase CSS .code-textarea min-height from 200px to 500px to accommodate longer content
All content in Bahasa Indonesia sopan - absolutely no gue/gua/elo/elu

CTA buttons must use these exact URLs: WhatsApp (https://wa.me/+6287781896087), Info Produk (https://pastijaga.petrusjakub.workers.dev/), Peluang Karir Agen (https://pastijaga.petrusjakub.workers.dev/pages/bisnis), Follow @petrusjakub (https://instagram.com/petrusjakub)
acceptance_criteria: File has exactly 21 post-card divs with textarea elements
Each textarea content is at least 50 lines long (significantly longer than the previous ~20 lines)
All posts contain: bold, italic, underline, highlight spans, blockquote with quote, image placeholder, 4 CTA buttons
All 4 CTA button URLs are correct in every post
Content has multiple paragraphs with storytelling, statistics, product details, and emotional hooks
verification: Run: wc -l /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week1.html - should be significantly larger than 1183 (target: 2500+)
Run: grep -c 'pastijaga.petrusjakub.workers.dev/' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week1.html - should be at least 42 (2 per post)
findings: User instruction was scoped incrementally. First batch: posts 1-3 (Day 1, MiUltimate HealthCare). Second batch: posts 4-6 (Day 2, MiWealth Protection). Third batch: posts 7-9 (Day 3, MiEducation). Fourth batch: posts 10-12 (Day 4, MiRetirement Booster - Pensiun yang Tenang). Fifth batch: posts 16-18 (Day 6, Peluang Karir Agen - Rekrutmen). Each post expanded to 25-35 lines with deeper storytelling, real-life scenarios, detailed statistics, emotional hooks about financial freedom and time freedom as Manulife agents, and comprehensive explanations. All CTA buttons retained with correct URLs. No prohibited words used.
